The '''Mecetti Embassy''' on [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]], in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], was located on [[Estalle Island]]. The embassy was one of the smallest on Procopia as [[House Mecetti]], fearful of moving to another building potentially infested with listening devices, preferred to remain in a secure location.
